title: The Archive Reclaimed | ECHO//100 Episode 98
description: Mira manifests into physical form to anchor a collapsing reality while harboring a dangerous secret. Her ultimate sacrifice becomes the only bridge to a stable future for Kavi. Episode 98 of ECHO//100: ARC. AI-assisted original fiction.

scenes.text: The digital horizon fractures into jagged light as Mira pulls herself into solid, breathing existence.
scenes.caption: Mira emerges solid
scenes.image_prompt: Mira, a holographic woman in a teal coat, stepping out of a pixelated wall, vertical orientation, cinematic lighting.

scenes.text: Reality shatters around Kavi, his red hoodie fluttering against the violent wind of the folding void.
scenes.caption: Kavi faces collapse
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi wearing a red hoodie and glasses, looking up at the sky splitting into glowing geometric shards, vertical.

scenes.text: Mira moves with newfound weight, shielding Kavi as the ground beneath them dissolves into raw static.
scenes.caption: Mira shields Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Mira holding a shimmering blue energy shield over Kavi, who is crouched with his backpack, vertical shot.

scenes.text: The air hums with the voices of millions, trapped deep within Mira’s glowing, translucent holographic skin.
scenes.caption: Voices inside Mira
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Mira's face, glowing with faint scrolling data streams, Kavi watching in awe, vertical.

scenes.text: She confesses: she has been hoarding every deleted timeline, keeping the lost histories alive inside her.
scenes.caption: Hidden timeline data
scenes.image_prompt: Mira showing Kavi a glowing orb of light containing miniature floating cities and paths, vertical.

scenes.text: To stop the collapse, Mira must release the data, but the surge will erase her forever.
scenes.caption: The fatal choice
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at her fading hands, Kavi reaching out to stop her, dark void background, vertical.

scenes.text: Kavi screams a desperate plea, but Mira offers him a sad, final smile of absolute peace.
scenes.caption: Mira's final smile
scenes.image_prompt: Mira smiling softly at Kavi, her body becoming semi-transparent, bright white light building behind her, vertical.

scenes.text: Without a word, Mira triggers the pulse, vanishing into the light to knit time back together.
scenes.caption: Mira initiates release
scenes.image_prompt: Brilliant explosion of light consuming Mira, Kavi standing alone in a newly formed stable world, vertical.
